policy.sourceExpression:
let
 Source = LoadMart("fct_product_event"),
 Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Source, {{"event_id", type text}, {"user_id", type text}, {"account_id", type text}, {"date_day", type date}, {"month", type date}, {"occurred_at", type datetime}, {"event_name", type text}}, "en-US"),
 Filtered = Table.SelectRows(Typed, each [occurred_at] >= RangeStart and [occurred_at] < RangeEnd)
in Filtered

instructions: Apply as table.refreshPolicy using TOM/XMLA after validating Snowflake query folding. Do not enable for the CSV demo. Refresh older partitions explicitly for events arriving later than seven days.
